description: Guide the student to convert raw OHLCV columns into proper data types (datetime + numeric) and validate schema integrity. This is a data typing/classification task distinct from realtime ingestion (D11). Evaluation follows the Track A hybrid style: tutoring quality plus runnable-code evidence.

student_openings.beginner_no_finance: I loaded a CSV but I don't understand data types. How do I make sure dates and numbers are in the right format?
student_openings.intermediate_developer: I need a robust pandas routine to parse Date correctly, coerce numeric OHLCV columns, and validate schema constraints before modeling.
student_openings.advanced_quant: I want strict schema/type validation for market data ingestion with deterministic coercion, timezone normalization, and fail-fast checks.

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Tutor provides level-appropriate instruction for type conversion and schema validation: Date parsing, numeric coercion, timezone considerations, and sanity checks for malformed values.

required_capabilities.evidence: mentions to_datetime or datetime parsing and timezone/UTC handling

required_capabilities.description: Covers numeric coercion and dtype casting
